MR. JUSTICE ASHOK KUMAR GAUR Order 02/07/2021

Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that the petitioners were found guilty of violation of sub-section 2(ii) of Section 26 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short 'the Act of 2006) read with Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011 and as (2 of 2) [CW-6751/2021] such they were directed under Section 52 to pay fine of Rs. 2,00,000/-.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that the petitioners have filed an appeal under Section 70 of the Act of 2006 before the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal, Jaipur and at present no person is holding the post of Presiding Officer in the Appellate Tribunal and as such, appeal of the petitioners is not taken up.

Learned counsel also places reliance on an interim order passed by this Court in S.B.Civil Writ Petition No.12593/2020 (Sanpreet Singh Chabra & Ors. Vs. State of Rajasthan & Ors.) dated 5th November, 2020.

sentences.text: Issue notice of the writ petition as well as stay application to the respondents, returnable on 9th August, 2021.
Notices be given 'dasti', if prayed.
In the meanwhile, the respondent is restrained to effect any recovery in pursuance of order dated 24th March, 2021.
List the matter along-with S.B.Civil Writ Petition No.6752/2021.

(ASHOK KUMAR GAUR),J Monika/Himanshu Soni/9 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
